# Refresh the same market overview state and confirm deterministic sparklines

> Prove the market overview re-renders the same sparkline traces for the same state because the sparklines use deterministic mock data.

## Step 1

Open {{start_url}} in a browser and wait until the ORBITAL single-page dashboard finishes rendering with the Market Overview section visible in the main workspace.

## Step 2

In the Market Overview section, store the currently rendered sparkline traces for S&P 500, NASDAQ, DOW, and BTC/USD as baseline_sparklines.

## Step 3

Refresh the same browser page without changing any dashboard state, and wait until the Market Overview renders again.

## Step 4

Assert the sparkline traces for S&P 500, NASDAQ, DOW, and BTC/USD exactly match baseline_sparklines after the refresh.

## Step 5 — assert @verifies ac-94

Confirm absolute check: Sparkline traces for the four market rows match their baseline traces after a repeated render of the same market overview state. (equals) — the stated promise: Sparkline traces remain identical across repeated renders of the same market overview state.
